verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents turning static mockups into shareable interactive prototypes, and the team says outputs are HTML/CSS/JS. Community users report making animated SVGs, though the SVG export path strips animations unless worked around. There is no first-party documentation of state-to-state animation, conditions or variables, or scroll effects, so the advanced depth of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented transitions/animation between prototype states, conditional logic or variables, scroll effects, and hands-on corroboration of advanced prototype behavior.

support.subject: As a designer, prototypes can carry advanced behavior — animation between states, conditions or variables, scroll effects — to feel like the real product

citations.quote: Turn a static mockup into a shareable, interactive prototype you can test with real people.
Designers can turn static mockups into easily-shareable interactive prototypes to gather feedback and user-test
Claude's designs are HTML/CSS/JS that any editor can handle
I've been using Claude Design to make animated SVGs.
